text: Retracted the assessment that constraint is enum drift. It shipped in the initial commit, is documented in docs/reference.md with defined escalation semantics, and appears in PAWL-008 as one of three claim types. Its zero uses follow from CLAUDE.md instructing agents not to cite spec: evidence until PAWL-009 exists, so a constraint claim would be permanently unverified — unused because a dependency is late, not because it was unwanted. I inferred intent from a usage count over 84 claims written in one session by an agent writing specs rather than implementing against them
